title: Driving an AND gate testbench
description: You can connect test signals to a component and read its expected results.

steps.description: The testbench declares and2 as a component. You create a two-bit input signal and a single output signal internally.
The port map wires the two input bits to a and b. You connect z to the signal checked by the process.

steps.question: How many different binary input combinations does this process apply?
steps.answer: Four: 00, 01, 10 and 11. Each has an output assertion.

steps.description: The assertions expect zero for the first three combinations and one for 11. You see Testbench finished in the recorded output without a shown failure report.
